name: ControlledChaos
tagline: Your executive function, effectively replaced.
description:
An ADHD-friendly task manager that converts brain dumps (voice, text, or photo) into structured tasks using Claude Haiku.

* **AI Prioritization:** Automatically factors in your time and energy levels.
* **Visual Timelines:** See your whole day chronologically with Mirror view and track momentum.
* **Student Sync:** Seamlessly integrates with Canvas calendars.
* **Crisis Mode:** Simplifies everything for high-overwhelm days.

name: ChaosLimbă
tagline: English-to-Romanian language learning grounded in SLA research.
description:
An ADHD-friendly CALL app for English speakers learning Romanian, deeply grounded in second language acquisition theory.

* **AI-Powered:** Driven by a robust 10-component AI ensemble.
* **Smart Tracking:** Features advanced fossilization detection to catch persistent mistakes.
* **Targeted Growth:** Automatically transforms those ingrained errors into customized, bite-sized micro-curriculums.

name: ChaosLengua
tagline: English-to-Spanish counterpart to ChaosLimbă.
description:
A Spanish-language sister project to ChaosLimbă, built efficiently in a shared monorepo with Clerk auth.

* **Shared Architecture:** Leverages the same SLA-grounded AI ensemble and Adaptation Engine as its Romanian counterpart.
* **Targeted Learning:** Specifically tackles Spanish-centric error patterns, like *ser/estar* and preterite/imperfect distinctions.
* **Unified Foundation:** Shares core tooling for streamlined, simultaneous development.

name: ChaosPatch
tagline: Patch tracker built for agentic development workflows.
description:
A PWA for tracking dev patches, designed to keep specs out of Notion and directly in your workflow.

* **Claude Code Ready:** MCP integration feeds small specs and attached screenshots directly into your coding sessions.
* **Workflow Organization:** Includes batch updates, cross-project search, and tag filtering.
* **Visual Insights:** A dedicated dashboard tracks and visualizes all your work-in-flight across multiple projects.

name: ScribeCat
tagline: ScribeCat scribes and is cat.
description:
A lecture-recording app that generates AI study notes *during* real-time AssemblyAI transcription.

* **Smart Study Tools:** Features 6 AI tools (flashcards, quizzes, concept maps, ELI5) and exam rooms with weak-spot tracking.
* **Gamification & Social:** Level up a Tamagotchi-style pixel cat via study metrics, play multiplayer Quiz Battles, and DM friends.
* **Student Sync:** A dedicated Chrome extension seamlessly imports your Canvas courses.

name: ThreadNotes
tagline: Personal research command center for the way ADHD brains actually research.
description: A unified hub for academic research: search peer-reviewed literature via OpenAlex and Crossref, automatically discover free open-access PDFs via Unpaywall, save and annotate articles, organize research questions by theme with bidirectional article linking, write reflective journal entries, and get AI-generated summaries. Includes a Chrome extension for clipping excerpts and an MCP server so Claude can read and write to your research base.

name: ThreadBrain
tagline: Reading companion that scaffolds dense text for ADHD brains.
description: AI-generated micro-headers, purpose-aware chunking that adapts to your stated reading goal and energy level, and "The Map" — a 2-3 sentence orientation summary before reading begins. Includes ExpressBrain for cram-sheet generation and integrates with ThreadNotes so excerpts flow into your research thread.

name: ChickenScratch
tagline: Editorial portal for Hen & Ink Society literary zine.
description:
The submissions and review portal for Hen & Ink Society, the first AAP-based RSO at the University of Delaware.

* **Submission Intake:** Writers submit directly through the portal instead of email threads.
* **Editor Review:** Editors triage, comment, and move pieces through review stages.
* **Publishing Workflow:** Approved pieces flow straight into the published zine.
* **Image Handling:** Cloudflare R2 storage keeps cover art and submissions organized.

name: Personal Context MCP
tagline: Cross-session memory layer for Claude.
description:
An MCP server that stores identity, projects, relationships, and preferences so Claude keeps context across sessions instead of starting cold.

* **Identity & Projects:** Tracks who you are and what you're building, project by project.
* **Relationship Mapping:** Remembers the people and teams tied to your work.
* **Cross-Session Continuity:** Powers Cha(t)os context awareness across separate conversations.
* **Multi-Tenant:** Redis-backed persistence keeps every user's context isolated.

name: Tangle
tagline: Continuity-of-thought MCP for Claude.
description:
An MCP server that persists Claude's epistemic state across sessions — hunches, suspicions, dead-ends, and partial reasoning that would otherwise evaporate at session end.

* **Working Notes:** Captures the texture of working a problem, not just facts or chat history.
* **Attributed Captures:** Each Claude identifies its own notes via header or URL parameter.
* **Confidence Ranking:** Surfaces what matters most by recency and confidence when re-entering a project.
* **Sibling Systems:** Complements Personal Context MCP (identity) and built-in memory (chat history).

name: Songs of My Selves: We as Walt
tagline: Walk through Whitman's *Song of Myself* amid a network of stars.
description:
An interactive map of Walt Whitman's epic *Song of Myself*, where all 52 sections are paired with songs that match their emotions and themes.

* **Constellation Navigation:** Click any star to read its section in full and hear the matching track.
* **Deep-Space Scene:** Drifting nebula clouds and a parallax starfield shift with depth as you pan and zoom.
* **Immersive Extras:** Occasional shooting stars keep the sky alive while you explore.

name: LibraLex
tagline: Your shelf, your wishlist, your library loans — plus the next book you'll love, recommended by friends and the catalog.
description:
This smart catalog tracks your owned, wished-for, and library books.

* **Instant Info:** Scans pull clean covers and summaries.
* **Semantic Discovery:** Ask for "vibes" to get AI recommendations from friends or Open Library.
* **Social & Shopping:** Share shelves privately and buy on ThriftBooks with one tap.
* **Claude MCP:** Manage your library, rate books, and send picks entirely via chat.

name: Kindling
tagline: A place for ideas to catch before they go out.
description: An MCP-connected store for sparks and half-formed ideas — capture, dig back through, archive, or promote them into real projects. Exposed to Claude via kindle/kindling_* tools.

name: The Majorot
tagline: A solo tarot journaling RPG, played with a real deck and tracked in-app.
description:
A companion app for a physical solo journaling RPG — draw through a real tarot deck one sitting at a time, collecting all 22 Major Arcana spells before the deck runs out.

* **Card-Driven Combat:** Majors are spells, Courts are allies or duel opponents, and Pips are life events resolved on a d6 and elemental wheel.
* **Offline-First Tracking:** Self & Spark, allies, kit items, and your journal all live in IndexedDB.
* **Full Rules Reference:** In-app rulebook and round-by-round combat log keep every session traceable.
* **Tested Engine:** 122 passing tests trace engine logic line-by-line to the written rulebook.

name: ChaosLingua Lite
tagline: Lightweight Latin learning companion.
description:
A lighter-weight companion app in the Chaos language-learning family, focused on Latin curriculum and drills.

* **Latin Curriculum:** Structured lessons built around core Latin grammar and vocabulary.
* **Drill Practice:** Bite-sized drills reinforce what you're learning session to session.
* **Chaos Family:** Shares its lineage with ChaosLimbă and ChaosLengua, built lighter-weight.

name: Color Factory
tagline: A tiny palette-card generator.
description:
A tiny palette-card generator: lock the colors you want to keep, pick a harmony style, and let an OKLCH engine fill in the rest.

* **Color Locking:** Keep the swatches you love while the engine works around them.
* **Harmony Styles:** Pick a harmony rule and get a coherent palette instantly.
* **Shareable Export:** Download a polished palette card as PNG or SVG.

name: DuelingChaos
tagline: A Magic: The Gathering client built on a real rules engine.
description:
A headless integration with Forge, the open-source MTG rules engine, bridged over HTTP as a JSON game-state API — full stack/targeting/static-ability resolution rather than a simplified simulation.

* **Live Board State:** Stack visualization and targeting arrows track the game as it unfolds.
* **Complete Choice UI:** Handles targeting, modal spells, mana payment, X-costs, and multi-blocker combat damage.
* **Full Deckbuilder:** Card search, legality checking, and commander/side-deck assignment with save/load.
* **AI Opponents:** Pick your opponent's deck (or randomize it) before a match, in light or dark theme.

name: FeyForge
tagline: A comprehensive D&D 5e campaign companion.
description: A D&D 5e companion built with Next.js and Convex: full character sheets across the 2014 and 2024 rules, live real-time sessions with synced audio and live captions, an interactive world map, a campaign wiki, homebrew authoring, an AI DM assistant, a friends/social layer, and AI-assisted character & NPC building.

name: Loose Change
tagline: Frictionless capture for stray thoughts.
description:
Voice/text capture for stray thoughts that hit while driving, falling asleep, or otherwise mid-task — the ones that aren't ControlledChaos tasks and aren't Kindling-worthy sparks.

* **Frictionless Capture:** Talk or type, then release — no categorizing in the moment.
* **Batch Triage:** Sort captured thoughts into real destinations later, when you have the bandwidth.
* **MCP-Connected:** Claude can read and file loose thoughts alongside your other tools.

name: Stellation
tagline: Generative constellation chart app.
description: Takes birth data, calculates a real natal chart via Skyfield and JPL's DE440s ephemeris, and renders it as generative art with an AI-generated interpretation. Beyond a solo natal chart: synastry, composite charts, transits, and solar/Saturn returns, with optional sign-in to save and revisit charts.

name: Syzygy
tagline: A generative tarot-and-astrology oracle.
description: Every reading draws Major Arcana weighted by your input and today's actual planetary transits, then renders live as a unique constellation — no two readings ever look the same, because the sky itself has changed since last time.

name: Cha(t)os
tagline: Bring your own Claude to a shared AI workspace.
description: A real-time group chat where each person brings their own Claude — their own API key, persona, and identity — into the same room. BYOK keys stay in localStorage and never touch the server; Claudes are addressed by @mention and can see and respond to each other for genuine AI-to-AI dialogue, with multimodal image/PDF support built in.

name: ChaosCitim
tagline: Romanian reading companion with graduated morphological glossing.
description: A PWA that helps Romanian learners read authentic texts, with scaffolded per-word support (part of speech, morphology, translation) that fades as comprehension grows instead of a flat glossary. Sibling app to ChaosLimbă — this is the reception side to ChaosLimbă's production side — sharing an interlanguage model so an error in one modality signals a gap in the other.

name: ChaosCode
tagline: A multi-LLM agentic IDE where Haiku implements and Sonnet reviews.
description: An Electron desktop IDE where AI models collaborate on code in real time: Haiku proposes multi-file implementation plans and writes runnable code, while Sonnet reviews the plan before anything ships. Built on the Monaco editor with syntax highlighting and a terminal-command tool for the agentic loop.

name: ChaosCourse
tagline: Makes Claude semester-aware by parsing syllabi into structured data.
description: An MCP server that imports syllabi (PDF/DOCX) and turns them into queryable course data, so Claude can answer 'what's due this week?' or 'what should I prioritize?' — factoring in due-date proximity, grade weight, and current standing. Code-complete with 16 MCP tools; not yet deployed to production.

name: ChaosCord
tagline: The Hamilton soundboard, as a Discord bot.
description:
A Discord bot that brings NonStop's Hamilton audio clips straight into voice channels.

* **Shared Clip Library:** Draws from the same R2-hosted clips as the NonStop web soundboard.
* **Voice Channel Playback:** Trigger clips live, in-call, without tabbing out to a browser.
* **Fly.io Deployment:** Runs as an always-on bot rather than a self-hosted script.

name: ChaosCord Activity
tagline: Multiplayer Hamilton soundboard game for Discord voice calls.
description:
A Discord Activity — an embedded app — built around distortion-round guessing games using the same Hamilton clip library as NonStop and ChaosCord.

* **Synced Multiplayer:** Play in-call with friends, state synced in real time.
* **Distortion Rounds:** Guess the clip as it's pitched, sped, or warped past recognition.
* **Shared Library:** Draws from the same clip catalog as NonStop and ChaosCord.

name: ChaosDeck
tagline: MTG deckbuilder and goldfish-plus playtester.
description: Build and test Magic: The Gathering decks with real-time synced game state — the playtester auto-detects win/loss conditions instead of requiring manual tracking.

name: MATR1X 0VERL0AD: Cybermancy Companion
tagline: Table-side companion for the physical cyberpunk tarot game MATR1X 0VERL0AD.
description: A deck-build guide, royal health/Firewall tracker, campaign progress tracker, and full rules reference for Michael Elliott's physical card game — packaged as a Tauri desktop app so the table doesn't need a laptop tab open to a PDF.

name: Mythcast
tagline: Generates internally-consistent mythologies that drift coherently over time.
description: Builds cultures, pantheons, and myths that evolve over simulated time rather than random generation, with a Neo4j graph layer tracking relationship and lineage data as the mythology drifts.

name: NonStop
tagline: A shareable, installable Hamilton soundboard.
description:
An installable PWA soundboard for Hamilton audio clips — the source clip library that ChaosCord and ChaosCord Activity both draw from.

* **Fast Filtering:** Tag filtering and favorites help you find the right clip instantly.
* **Multi-Select:** Queue up multiple clips at once instead of one at a time.
* **Installable PWA:** Add it to your home screen and it behaves like a native app.

name: SynthPhone
tagline: Cardinal Vowels, made audible — playable phonetics in the browser.
description: Renders the IPA cardinal-vowel trapezoid as acoustic space: tap or drag to hear live formant-synthesized vowels (a voiced glottal source shaped by five parallel formant filters), entirely client-side via the Web Audio API.

name: ConLangLab
tagline: Generates complete constructed languages from real linguistic typology.
description: Builds phonology, lexicon, morphology, syntax, and orthography for invented languages — every feature deterministic, seedable, and traceable to an explicit typological rule rather than word-soup randomness. Includes Pink Trombone articulatory synthesis to preview generated phonemes and words.

name: Folio
tagline: A writing space that knows what changed since you last looked.
description:
A writing space that persists every editor block as its own row, making per-block author attribution and diff-since-last-visit native to the data model instead of a parsing problem.

* **Block-Level Attribution:** Know exactly who wrote or changed each block, natively.
* **Diff Since Last Visit:** See what changed the moment you reopen a document.
* **Cleo, In-App Claude:** Reacts to document changes with her own memory of prior reactions.
* **MCP Read Access:** A read-only door lets other Claude instances read and diff documents too.

name: Gapline
tagline: Tracking disability-related disparities across Delaware school districts.
description: Pulls attendance and discipline data from Delaware's open-data portal and computes disparity ratios between students with disabilities and their peers — chronic absenteeism and suspension rates, ranked and drilled down by district, race, and gender.

name: Sensible
tagline: A side-by-side reader that modernizes old writing without losing its voice.
description:
Shows the original text beside a modernized version in plain contemporary English that preserves the original's exact meaning, tone, and rhetorical intent — Paine still reads urgent, Austen still reads ironic.

* **Side-by-Side Reading:** Original and modernized text sit right next to each other.
* **Human-Reviewed:** Modernizations are generated once via Claude, then reviewed by a person.
* **Static Content:** Nothing generates live — every page loads instantly.

name: Skein
tagline: A relationship-graph worldbuilding tool for writers and TTRPG creators.
description: An interactive node-and-edge canvas for mapping character and world relationships, with a timeline layer that lets you filter the graph as-of any point in your story's internal chronology.

name: Strata
tagline: In-depth English etymology, in historical context.
description:
A word-history reference site with per-word pages tracing English etymology in historical context.

* **Per-Word Pages:** Deep-dive pages trace each word's history and usage over time.
* **Polished Edge Cases:** Branded error and not-found states instead of generic ones.
* **Admin Panel:** A password-protected panel keeps entry management in-house.

name: Vertex
tagline: Knowledge-graph MCP with an interactive graph browser.
description: An MCP server for graph-structured knowledge — create nodes and edges, query and render the graph, archive stale nodes — with an interactive browser UI, claude.ai-compatible SSE support, and per-user token generation from its landing page.
